reply_text:
I’d block on **one issue**:

**[P1] Team and archive quotas become zero — `src/plans.js:11`.**  
`entry.quotaKiB << 10` coerces the value to a signed 32-bit integer. Both the 200 GiB team quota and 2 TiB archive quota evaluate to **0 bytes**, so even a 1-byte upload to an empty account is rejected. I reproduced this for both plans.

Use multiplication by `1024` instead, and add quota/upload tests for both paid plans before merging.

All 4 existing tests pass, but only cover the free-plan quota. No code changed.
